stem: Diya fills a number pyramid. Each box is the sum of the two boxes directly below it. The top box is $18$ and the lower-left box touching it is $5$. The lower-right box touching the top is missing.

parts.text: Which value belongs in the missing box?

options.text: $18$, copying the top label into the missing entry.
$13$, because the missing lower box is $18-5$.
$23$, because the missing lower box is $18+5$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The top box equals the sum of the two touching lower boxes, so the missing box is $18-5=13$.

teacher.key_rationale: Top = sum of two touching lower boxes, so missing = 18−5 = 13. Copying 18 or adding 18+5 mishandles the adjacent-sum rule.
